note: relationships[] findings from scripts/check-profiler-relationships.py that a human has reviewed and that need no dossier change. Each id is printed by the checker and hashes the facts behind the finding (both types for a reciprocal pair; slug, counterparty and url for an unregistered source), so editing either side reopens it. These are structural invariants: an entry here is an exception with a written reason, never a loosened rule. Seeded empty at X1 (v04.71r); X2 populates it. Method: repository-information/PROFILER-CROSSREF-CALIBRATION.md → Relationships checker.

accepted.why: Parent/subsidiary — Quanta owns Blattner outright. `portfolio` entered the enum on 2026-09-06 and was considered here, but it still misdescribes this pair: an operating parent's wholly-owned construction subsidiary is not a financial holding. The types actually missing are `parent`/`subsidiary`; `investor`/`other` remains the closest the schema allows, so this accept stands on its own reason rather than on the enum gap.

Two distinct relationships, both true: BYD competes with Sinexcel's C&I cabinets at system level while buying its battery formation & test equipment — competitor from BYD's side, customer from Sinexcel's
Cell customer AND BESS rival, both true at once: FinDreams supplies LFP cells to Tesla's Shanghai Megafactory while the two fight at the container layer — BYD types the supply link, Tesla the rivalry

Both true and both reasoned in their own context: Infineon supplies the silicon and packaging into Delta's module (supplier from Delta's side) and the two co-develop under a bilateral first-party release (partner from Infineon's side)

DPR leads the Stargate Abilene build that OpenAI's workloads anchor (supplier in OpenAI's construction bench) but contracts through developer Crusoe, so DPR's side is a deliberate `other` — indirect, not lazy; both dossiers name the Crusoe intermediation
Sponsor siblings under BlackRock after the GIP absorption — a corporate-structure link with no enum type; `other`/`other` is the honest typing and the checker reports `other` by design
Partner AND investor — both true: Google backstops ~$4.5B of Fluidstack-TeraWulf leases (partner) and took warrants equal to ~14% of TeraWulf (investor)
Partner AND investor — both true: ~27% stake plus the $250B Azure commitment; Microsoft types the commercial partnership, OpenAI the ownership

Former parent and its 2024 carve-out, co-owned until the July 2026 sale to Nextpower — a historical corporate-structure link with no enum type; `other`/`other` is the honest typing and the checker reports `other` by design

Both true at once: Amazon is X-energy's largest outside shareholder (23.4% of Class A) AND the anchor buyer of Xe-100 capacity (Cascade rights, 5 GW option). X-energy types the shareholder side `investor`; Amazon types the commercial side `supplier` because the enum has no `portfolio` value and the purchase relation is the one Amazon's own page describes.
